# Ádám Pintér

Transportation Engineer | 10+ Years in Railway Systems, Capacity Management & Digital Solutions

Vienna, Vienna, Austria (AT)

282 connections • 284 followers

## About

With over 10 years of experience in the railway sector, I specialize in connecting business needs, operational processes, and digital solutions. My career has evolved from railway operations and timetable planning to process development, product architecture, and international collaboration. As a Product Architect at RailNetEurope (RNE), I contribute to the design and evolution of integrated digital products supporting European railway capacity management. I work at the intersection of business, operations, and technology—translating complex requirements into coherent product concepts, facilitating collaboration across multidisciplinary teams, and helping ensure that solutions remain scalable, interoperable, and aligned with long-term strategic objectives. Previously, as a Capacity Manager at RNE, I played a key role in the European Timetable Redesign (TTR) programme, developing harmonised international processes and coordinating stakeholders from railway infrastructure managers across Europe. My work lies at the intersection of digital innovation, organization theory, and platform strategy—focusing on how emerging technologies such as AI, data infrastructure, and digital platforms reshape industries, institutions, and our collective future.
